whyPromptly.title: ✨ Why Promptly beats a plain AI model
whyPromptly.subtitle: We run a structured pipeline—spec building, question refining, multi-agent orchestration, scoring, and Outcome Runner selection—so you're never just sending a single prompt to an LLM.
whyPromptly.specBuilderDesc: Turn your raw idea into a structured spec so every requirement is explicit before we touch an LLM.
whyPromptly.questionEngineDesc: We ask targeted follow-up questions (Q1–Q3 flow) to remove ambiguity and surface context you might forget.
whyPromptly.llmAgentsDesc: Specialized agents (Architect, Editor, Judge, etc.) craft multiple candidate prompts instead of relying on a single response.
whyPromptly.metricsDesc: Every candidate is scored on clarity, coherence, style match, safety, token cost, and risk to quantify quality.
whyPromptly.outcomeDesc: The Outcome-First runner applies your success criteria, compares best-of-N candidates, and returns the most reliable result.
whyPromptly.specStructuredDesc: JSON-ready blueprint guides every subsequent stage.
whyPromptly.specOrchestrationDesc: Different agents collaborate on architecture, editing, and judgment.
whyPromptly.specSelectionDesc: We compare candidates rather than returning the first hit.
whyPromptly.specMetricsDesc: Coherence, style, pass rate, token efficiency, and risk scores feed into the payoff.
whyPromptly.specOutcomeDesc: Picks the winner according to your defined tests/criteria.
whyPromptly.callout: 🚀 Every enhancement passes through the Spec → Question → Agent → Outcome pipeline so the result you copy is the top-ranked candidate after multi-metric scoring.

userGuide.title: User Guide
userGuide.step1: Write your task: define Instruction + Constraints + Expected style.
userGuide.step2: Add test cases: for each input, provide ideal output.
userGuide.step3: Run: the system auto-searches, tests, and tunes prompts.
userGuide.step4: Review KPIs: Accuracy / F1 / Pass Rate / Token Cost / Progress% update after each run.
